{{Quote|You expect us to hunt here? With Imperials crawling all over us? And Sith?|Q'kal objects to hunting on Drommund Kaas|<ref name="TOR:TH" />}}
'''Q'kal''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who was active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR:TH" /> In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_dates">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> Q'kal was one of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] to attend the [[Great Hunt (c. 3643 BBY)|Great Hunt]] on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. However, when the Huntsmaster and Assistant Huntsmaster [[Lek]] announced that the competitors for the final melee were required to collect three bounties on Dromund Kaas, Q'kal feared going up against the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] and Imperials and decided to drop out. He advised a [[Hunter (individual)|young bounty hunter]] to do likewise.<ref name="TOR:TH" />
